title: Missing SECURITY comment on non-cryptographic compute_mic
description: Line 100: compute_mic uses CRC-32 which is NOT cryptographic. Add SECURITY comment explaining this provides error detection only, not authentication. Applications must use OSCORE.
close_reason: Fixed: Added SECURITY comment to compute_mic explaining CRC-32 is not cryptographic and provides error detection only, not authentication. Applications must use OSCORE.
